column1: # EXCLUDED — GPU VRAM OOM on a 2-GPU pod (needs ~23.5GB alone, the whole
# 3090, leaving nothing for the renderer's GPU on the same pod). Confirmed
# via a standalone 1-GPU/80Gi-RAM Job (simwam-smoketest): loads fine on
# system RAM, dies in simwam.runtime.create_simwam -> torch OOM at
# instantiate. Source machine (bolei-gpu07) had 8 GPUs and dedicated one
# fully to NAVSAFE_VLA_GPU; our pods only get 2 total. Run these on a
# dedicated single-GPU-per-model setup elsewhere, not in this sweep.
